payload.title: stories save-version reminder can name the wrong next step right after a save
payload.description: On 2026-11-04, saving version 6 of a Story printed: next direction, Give the research direction. Read straight afterward, stories next correctly gave copy_edit, with direction done. The reminder printed by the write disagreed with the read command on the same Story. Possibly a read of Assignments that returned nothing during the reminder, which should report unknown and never send someone back to a finished step.
